description: Grey plates split by one bright cyan seam that runs clean through. It bites frost, and what it strikes runs late.
lore: Warm, which is the first surprise — off the crystal ground, out of a shape that is ice from the crown down, and it sits in the palm at blood heat, the seam warmest of all. The sorters point to that when asked whether anything in a [[monsters/ice_crystal_golem|Rimeshard]] was ever under way at all: watched from a ridge it might as well be weather, and weather does not leave a warm stone.

The grading is done on the seam, not on either material. Sight along it: on a good one the cyan enters one face and comes out the other, clean through. On a poor one it stops inside, and what you own is a grey pebble with a stripe. The rock alone is worth nothing; the ice alone is worth nothing; the join is the worth.

New hands find that funny for about a week. [[characters/54bead23|Osric]] did not laugh at all. He is a smith; a join that outvalues both its pieces was the first price in this country that struck him as honestly arrived at, and he paid it without haggling, which the stone-sellers still bring up.
